items.t: MongoDB Stock (MDB): Wells Fargo Says Buy Ahead of Earnings After Positive Customer Survey
items.sum: U.S. database provider MongoDB (MDB) is preparing to release its fiscal Q3 2027 earnings next Tuesday, December 1, after market close. Ahead of the results, Ryan MacWilliams, a five-star analyst at Wells Fargo (WFC), has assigned a Buy rating on MDB stock. He set a $475 price target, predicting about 52% upside. MacWilliams is bullish on the positive findings from Wells Fargo’s first MongoDB Atlas
